hero.title: Bring your community tontines online, without the friction.
hero.subtitle: Tontiin pairs the trust of the traditional tontine with the rigour of a tracking tool: rounds, payouts, cash reserve, penalties, solidarity and the loan fund — in one place, visible to every member.
hero.note: Create an account to start your own tontine, or join one through your administrator's invitation link.

solutions.title: Built for members. Designed for administrators.
solutions.subtitle: Switch between the contributor's simplified view and the full dashboard for running your groups.

member.title: Everything legible, on mobile
member.description: Every member follows their contributions, score, cash reserve and payout date without having to ask anyone.
points: Payout order and current round available at any time
Penalties and scores visible to everyone, no exception
Contribution and loan history kept round after round

admin.title: Full control over your tontines
admin.description: Set up rounds, payout order, penalties and the loan fund. Invite members with a single-use link and keep a trace of every operation.
points: Several tontines run in parallel from one account
Penalties, solidarity and top-ups applied in a few clicks
Single-use invitations, no password to share

preview.activityPending: Trade group — cash reserve to top up

features.title: Everything you need to run your tontines
features.subtitle: No more lost notebooks, forgotten payments or end-of-round disputes.

rounds.title: Rounds & payouts
rounds.description: Open a round, set the monthly contribution and assign the payout order by hand.

scoring.title: Transparent scoring
scoring.description: Everyone starts at 0 and can see every member's penalties. Reset to zero on each new round.

solidarity.title: Solidarity
solidarity.description: Fixed-amount events, deducted from every member's cash reserve except the beneficiary.

loans.title: Loan fund
loans.description: Standalone fund, interest deducted up front at disbursement, single repayment at maturity.

reserve.title: Cash reserve
reserve.description: Every member funds their own reserve; deductions and top-ups are tracked to the last franc.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.description: A unique link, valid for a few hours and usable only once, to bring a member into the tontine.

trust.title: The cash box is never in one person's hands.
trust.subtitle: Every action leaves a trace, and every round closes with a report handed to the group. That is what separates a tontine kept in a notebook from a tontine kept in Tontiin.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every amount entered, changed or cancelled leaves a dated, signed line. Nobody rewrites the group's history — not even the administrator.
points: A written line is never erased

report.title: End-of-round report
report.description: When a round closes, the full statement is generated and shared: contributions, recipient, penalties, cash balance.
points: Generated automatically when the round closes
Readable and exportable by every member
A complete record, round after round
